verdict.rationale: Brex markets built-in background automation: AI-powered invoice entry, approval and payments, automated GL coding, and auto-enforced budget controls. User-defined autonomous workflows mostly depend on external tools, namely webhooks plus Pipedream/Zapier recipes such as monthly-resetting stipend cards and a scheduled monthly CSV export. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation or agent builder inside Brex, documentation of how users define their own triggers and actions in-product, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably unattended.
